Fix A_car=A in one packet. Then K_car=2*L*A^2 is fixed.
Every endpoint satisfies
V_norm*J_car=K_car
with V_norm,J_car positive integers.
Thus J_car runs through positive divisors of K_car, at most


tau(K_car)=B^o(1)


values in the retained polynomial physical range.


Each J_car fixes

Consequently, if A_A(B) is the number of active A_car values,


E_psi(B) <= B^o(1)*A_A(B).


This upper bound is the only direction needed if a future theorem proves A_A(B)<<B^(1/12-delta).

The original provisional card wrote
A_A(B) <= E_psi(B).
That exact inequality silently assumes one retained A_car value per endpoint. Earlier cards explicitly allow nonunique retained core representations, so that exact inequality is not licensed.


It is replaced by a power-scale statement.

- the four-core norm partition tau=tau0*tau1*tau2*tau3 has at most 4^omega(tau)=B^o(1) prime-power allocations;
- M_rel and Nrel are then determined by the fresh/content split of the relative cores;

on the fixed packet. Thus

have the same polynomial exponent.


This restores the intended power-scale equivalence, but it also changes the interpretation: A_car is an alternate one-dimensional arithmetic coordinate for the already-existing active-tau gate, not a newly smaller support set by itself.

M3-T11-109 survives hostile audit.


Promotable:
- for every nonzero rational u, the rational 1+3 specialization locus of Q_u is exactly the explicit degree-4 image phi(P^1(Q)) minus the u=0 image;
- the quartic-discriminant-square locus is exactly the explicit degree-2 image psi(P^1(Q));

- the stated O(H^(1/2)) and O(H) estimates are valid ambient multiplicative-projective-u-height counts only.


Not promoted:
- any same-physical-measure R<=B fixed-power saving;
- any primary-gate closure;
- endpoint theorem;
- P(B)/M3(B)->0;
- Perfect Cuboid nonexistence credit.


2. Rational-root locus — PASS


Retain
Q_u(z)=(1+u^2)z^4-8u z^3+(11u^2-1)z^2+6u z-u^2.


Regarded as a quadratic in u, independent exact expansion gives
Disc_u(Q_u(z))=-4z^2(z^2-2)^3=4z^2(2-z^2)^3.


For u!=0, a rational root has z!=0. The leading quadratic coefficient z^4+11z^2-1 has no rational zero because its equation in z^2 has discriminant 125. Hence a rational root exists exactly when
z^2+w^2=2
for rational z,w.


The standard rational parametrization
z=(t^2-2t-1)/(t^2+1),
w=-(t^2+2t-1)/(t^2+1)
substitutes identically into Q after
u=phi(t)
=-2(t-1)(t^2-2t-1)/(t^4-6t^3+12t^2-14t+11).


Changing w to -w exchanges the two quadratic roots in u, so the parametrization is complete rather than one-sided.

U_13=-2s(r-s)(r^2-2rs-s^2),
V_13=r^4-6r^3s+12r^2s^2-14rs^3+11s^4,
and independent resultant recomputation gives
Res_r(U_13,V_13)=-4096s^16.
Thus all reduction cancellation for primitive (r,s) is supported at 2, the map has degree 4, and
h(phi(t))=4h(t)+O(1).
Consequently the ambient u-height image count is O(H^(1/2)).


3. A4 discriminant-square locus — PASS


Independent discriminant recomputation gives
Disc_z(Q_u)=-16u^2(1+u^2)^2(25u^2-2)^3,
so its squareclass for u!=0 is [2-25u^2].


Therefore the square-discriminant locus is the conic
y^2=2-25u^2.
With X=5u this is X^2+y^2=2, giving the complete parametrization
u=psi(t)=(t^2-2t-1)/(5(t^2+1)).


Homogeneously,
U_A4=r^2-2rs-s^2,
V_A4=5(r^2+s^2),
and independent resultant recomputation gives
Res_r(U_A4,V_A4)=200s^4.
Hence psi has degree 2, h(psi(t))=2h(t)+O(1), and the ambient u-height image count is O(H).


4. Disjointness — PASS


Independent substitution verifies
2-25phi(t)^2
=
2(t^2+2t-1)^2
(t^4-16t^3+72t^2-124t+71)
/
(t^4-6t^3+12t^2-14t+11)^2.


Thus an intersection point would give
Y^2=2F(r,s),
F=r^4-16r^3s+72r^2s^2-124rs^3+71s^4.


On P^1(F_5), direct evaluation gives 2F values
2,3,3,2,3
at finite t=0,1,2,3,4 and 2 at infinity.
These are nonzero nonsquares modulo 5. Hence the two rational images are disjoint.


5. Galois trichotomy — PASS


Audited M3-T11-108 proves that the standard cubic resolvent is irreducible over Q for every u in Q^*, so no 2+2 factorization exists.


On the phi image, Q_u has a rational linear factor. The remaining cubic cannot be reducible without producing a forbidden additional quartic factorization/resolvent reduction. Disjointness from psi makes the quartic discriminant nonsquare. Therefore the cubic factor is irreducible with Galois group S3.


On the psi image, there is no linear factor and no 2+2 factor, hence Q_u is irreducible. Its cubic resolvent is irreducible and its discriminant is square, so the quartic Galois group is A4.


Off both images, Q_u is irreducible, the cubic resolvent is irreducible, and the discriminant is nonsquare, so the quartic Galois group is S4.


Therefore every nonzero rational specialization has exactly one of:
